name: Oaken's Warm Swedish Meatballs over Egg Noodles / Mashed Potatoes (Wonder Alaska)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Freezing the Night Away Menu (Alaska Sailings)
whyItWorks: Finely ground tender Nordic meatballs in savory cream gravy over soft egg noodles or mashed potatoes require minimal mechanical digestion.
